title: listener_pose
description: Locator -> hub pose fix (LOCATOR_BRIEF.md section 2.4). position is the user's EAR position (center of the head) in the room frame: origin = floor point directly under the mat center, +x right, +y forward, +z up, units meters (section 2.1). t is the Unix epoch time (float) the position refers to: the MEASUREMENT time, not the send time. Publish rules (section 2.4): one pose per valid fix (~3.33 Hz with all 5 beacons); no pose when a cycle produced no valid fix; after 1.5 s with no valid fix, exactly ONE pose with quality 'lost' (holding the last position), then nothing until fixes resume.

position.description: Ear position [x, y, z] in meters, room frame per section 2.1. Equals the filtered microphone position plus the configured ear offset (section 6.8).

quality.description: ok: >= 4 beacons used, residual RMS <= 0.15 ms, fix from the current cycle (section 6.9). degraded: 3 beacons plus the height prior, or residual RMS between 0.15 and 0.30 ms. lost: no valid fix for 1.5 s.

beacons_heard.description: Number of beacons actually used in the solve. 0 is valid for manual mode (section 8.2) and for the lost emission, which repeats the last position without a new solve.

source.description: beacons: acoustic solve. steps: dead-reckoning fallback (section 8.8). sim: file-input mode (section 8.7). manual: Debug-screen joystick (section 8.2).

t.description: Unix epoch seconds (float) of the measurement time, converted from the phone sample clock using hostTime anchors (section 6.8).
